messages:
Alex: Heads-up — noticed a spike in DLQ replays from the metering-ingest topic this morning. After replayed events land, route_tag is missing on ~0.6% of events and invoice previews for a few tenants are off. Looks like header propagation is being lost somewhere during DLQ handling. :confused:

Maria: Ugh. Can you paste an example raw event + the post-replay one?

Alex: Sure, minimal example below (sanitized):

```
# original message headers: { tenant: t123, route_tag: heavy-embed }
payload: { tokens: 340, model: 'redwood/gpt-x' }
```

```
# after DLQ replay into ingest topic
# headers: { tenant: t123 }
payload: { tokens: 340, model: 'redwood/gpt-x' }
```

Sam: Interesting — DLQ consumer uses the 'kafka-republish' flow which currently strips Kafka headers by design unless configured. We changed that last year when switching libs.

Jana: Can confirm. The DLQ adapter path calls kafka-go's Republish(ctx, msg.Value) without copying Headers. There's an option to pass through headers but it was disabled because of a bug with null headers on older clients.

Liam: That explains missing route_tag. Missing route_tag -> default routing -> endpoint with different plan mapping -> invoice preview mismatch. We should not let DLQ replay change billing attribution.

ingest-bot: Incident created: MET-DLQ-ROUTETAG-1767777777 (linked: https://tickets.internal/INC-3258)

Maria: Proposed plan: 1) patch DLQ republish to copy headers when present (with defensive null checks). 2) Add a quick unit test reproducing header-less clients. 3) Deploy canary to 'staging-ingest' for 30m and monitor invoice-preview diffs. 4) Add a console flag to surface DLQ-origin header so UX teams can see when an event was replayed.

Sam: +1. Also suggest we add a small telemetry metric: dlq_replay_missing_route_tag{env} to alert if rate > 0.1% for >15m.

Jana: I can do the consumer patch today. Patch will be small: copy msg.Headers into the republish call and keep old fallback behavior. Question: do we need to also set a synthetic header like x-replayed-from-dlq=true to help queries?

Liam: Yes add the synthetic header. Console can read it and show "replayed" badge next to event in the preview. Also helps audit for billing.

Alex: If Jana can open a PR, I'll pair on tests. Maria, can you own the dashboard change to show replayed badge and expose the new metric?

Maria: Yep. I'll add a small card under Billing -> Ingest Telemetry and wire the alert (pager threshold same as Sam suggested). I'll also add a quick note in the rollout playbook to notify Billing on canary.

Sam: Heads up on rollout: there are a couple of consumers in k8s and an old on-prem consumer in prod for reseller-tenants that still runs v0.9. We need to ensure header-forwarding is compatible; otherwise the old consumer will still strip headers during future DLQ writes.

Jana: Good catch. I'll put compatibility guards and a feature flag 'dlq.copy_headers=true' defaulting to true for new CNs and add a helm var for on-prem that can be turned on when they upgrade.

Liam: For backfill: we should identify replays in the window (last 48h), re-ingest only events with missing route_tag and a matching original event available in the audit store. Backfill script should be manual-run with dry-run first.

Alex: I'll draft the backfill script tomorrow. Need a decision on whether to auto-correct invoices or just surface affected previews and require manual crediting. Finance prefers manual for now.

Maria: Finance ok with manual adjustments if we can produce a deterministic list and delta. Add a slice in the console export: tenant, original_ts, tokens, old_route, new_route, invoice_delta_estimate.

Sam: Also adding a small telemetry counter for 'dlq_replay_forwarded_headers' and 'dlq_replay_dropped_headers' so we can measure repair progress.

Jana: Opening PR shortly: https://git.internal/prs/12345 - includes unit test and runtime flag. I'll tag @Alex for review.

Alex: Reviewing now. Quick checklist for merge: a) unit tests, b) e2e canary script must pass in staging, c) helm var default set, d) migration doc in eng-platform/docs.

ingest-bot: Deploy canary started in cluster staging-ingest (manifest sha: abcdef123)

Maria: Canary telemetry looks good so far (10m). dlq_replay_missing_route_tag rate dropped to 0.02%. :thumbsup:

Liam: Great. Once staging is clear, let's schedule prod ramp with a 10% -> 50% -> 100% rollout and monitor invoice-preview diffs and dlq metrics at each step.

Alex: I'll coordinate the production window. Thanks everyone. I'll file a follow-up doc with the backfill plan and hand-off to Finance/SRE.

Maria: Adding the console changes to the next sprint and will open a small UX PR to add the 'Replayed' badge to invoice-preview rows.

Sam: Nice teamwork. Reminder: update the runbook to include how to inspect DLQ replays and the new metrics.

Jana: PR merged. Will monitor prod canary and report in this thread.

Alex: Closing loop — prod rollout completed, metrics stable, finance has the CSV for manual adjustments. Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
